body.name: Total clipped occupancy-weighted pilot
body.construction: On records \(1,\ldots,m_0\), form \(N_{ak}^{(0)}\), \(N_k^{(0)}\), \(J_k^{(0)}\), the guarded means \(\overline Y_{ak}^{(0)}\), and \(\widehat\Delta_k^{(0)}\). Set \(R_0=\sum_{k=1}^dN_k^{(0)}J_k^{(0)}\), use \(w_k^{(0)}=N_k^{(0)}J_k^{(0)}/R_0\) when \(R_0>0\) and \(w_k^{(0)}=0\) when \(R_0=0\), and return \(\widetilde\tau=\operatorname{clip}_{[-M,M]}(\sum_{k=1}^dw_k^{(0)}\widehat\Delta_k^{(0)})\). Thus an empty pilot, an entirely unmatched pilot, and every empty or one-arm-only pilot cell contribute zero, and every denominator is guarded.
